entities.text: Thota Rajakumari vs The Union Of India
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
The Hon'Ble Sri Justice K.Sarath
 Writ Petition No.9279 of 2024
Order:

This writ petition is filed under Article 226 of Constitution of India seeking the following relief:
"...to issue an appropriate Writ or order or direction preferably one in the nature of a Writ of Mandamus declaring the inaction of respondent No.3 in considering the representation of petitioner dt. 21-02-2024 u/s 3(g)(5) of the National Highways Act,
1956 for enhancement of compensation in respect of petitioner's land in Sy.No. 13/E to an extent of 1687.04 Sq.Mts. and in Sy. No.12/A3 to an extent of 915 Sq.Mtrs. of Shameerpet village of Jangaon Mandal and District against illegal fixation of land value u/s 26(1) of Act, 2013 by the 4th respondent authority

in respect of Sy Nos.12 and 13 of Shameerpet Village of Jangaon Mandal and District without providing opportunity to submit objections and on mere issuance of notice; passed impugned award No. B/1914/2017-2 dt. -02-2023 without following procedure contemplated under the Act, 2013 as well as National Highways Act, 1956 and deposited compensation unilaterally and arbitrarily as illegal, discriminatory, violative of principles of Natural Justice, apart from violative of Article 14, 21 and 300-A of Constitution of India consequently direct the respondent No.3 to consider the representation of petitioner dt.21-02-2024 u/s 3(g)(5) of the National Highways Act,1956 for enhancement of compensation in respect of petitioner's land in Sy. No.
13/E to an extent of 1687.04 Sq Mts. and in Sy. No. 12/A3 to an extent of 915 Sq.
Mtrs. of Shameerpet village of Jangaon Mandal and District and thereby enhance compensation in accordance with law within time frame preferably within four weeks and pass..."
2. Heard learned Counsel appearing for the petitioner, learned Government Pleader for Land Acquisition for the respondent Nos.2 to 4, Sri P.Harinath Gupta, learned Standing Counsel for National Highways Authority of India for the respondent No.5 and ::2::
learned Government Pleader for Roads and Buildings for the respondent No.6.
With the consent of both sides, this writ petition is disposed of at the stage of admission itself.

3. In view of the submissions made by the both sides, without going into the merits of the case, the present writ petition is disposed of by directing the respondent No.3 to consider the representation submitted by the petitioner on 21.02.2024 under Section 3(g)(5) of the National Highways Act, 1956 for enhancement of compensation in respect of the petitioner's land in Sy.No.13/E to an extent of 1687.04 Sq.mts. and in Sy.No.12/A3 to an extent of 915 Sq.mts. of Shameerpet Village of Jangaon Mandal and District, within a period of three (03) months from the date of receipt of copy of this Thota Rajakumari vs The Union Of India on 10 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/12249002/
1 order.
